{{Quote|The Ritual is not absolutely certain. It may be that the Heart can resist it. If so, we have lost.|Cheelru, on the Ritual of the Power of the Dark|<ref name="APOD" />}}
The '''Ritual of the Power of the Dark''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based rite drawn from ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings that could be used to generate the [[Force power/Legends|power]] to turn a [[ch'hala tree]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of Force]].<ref name="APOD" /> Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Len Markus]], the leader of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] shared information on the ritual with the Wyrd, a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Tarasin]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The [[First Witch of the Wyrd]], the leader of the witches, devised to use the ritual to force Cularin's [[Heart Tree|World Tree Ch'hala]] to embrace the dark side and submit to the Wyrd's control. The witches were uncertain whether the ritual would succeed at corrupting the ch'hala and the witch [[Cheelru]] opposed its use, but was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the First Witch after voicing her concerns.<ref name="APOD" />

After infecting the ch'hala with a [[Plague of Darkness|plague]] to render it sick and afraid, the witches launched the ritual to push the ch'hala permanently to the dark side. A group of senior Wyrd witches gathered around a sapling next to the ch'hala Heart Tree and the First Witch struck a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long, [[Color/Legends|black]] metallic rod into the tree and chanted in an archaic form of [[Tarasinese|Tarasin speech]], while focussing their power. The rite caused a purple-colored glow to be emitted from the wounded sapling and over a period of eleven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] the witches continued the ritual. However, the witches were forced to abandon the ritual after falling [[First skirmish at the Heart Tree|under attack]] from a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]].<ref name="APOD" />
